challenges.title: Branches left unchecked
challenges.desc: Branches often have no IT staff, so security is set up once, inconsistently, and never checked again.

challenges.title: No IT staff on site
challenges.desc: Branches run without specialists to check the setup.

challenges.title: Inconsistent sites
challenges.desc: Each branch set up differently means gaps nobody sees.

approach.title: Quick Mode for branch staff
approach.desc: Quick Mode lets non-specialist staff set up a branch correctly.

approach.title: VPN and SD-WAN to head office
approach.desc: Site-to-site VPN and SD-WAN join branches to head office.

approach.title: Multi-WAN failover
approach.desc: Keeps branches online when a line drops.

approach.title: Same features everywhere
approach.desc: The same features on the smallest branch box as at head office.

indiaContext: Available across India through our distributor and partner network, with 24/7 India-based support.

process.title: Identify
process.desc: We learn how your network is used: how many people, which sites, which systems matter most.

process.title: Analyze
process.desc: We recommend the right model and settings for your risks and your industry.

process.title: Protect

process.title: Adapt
process.desc: Regular updates, quarterly security reviews and 24/7 India-based support keep you protected as things change.

faqs.a: Ask our team about central management for multi-site deployments.

faqs.q: What if a branch loses its internet line?
faqs.a: Multi-WAN failover switches to a backup line automatically.

faqs.q: Which model suits a small branch?
faqs.a: Most small branches use SE20 or SE50. Use the model finder to check.
